tasks.summary: A remote client's public version endpoint must not be mistaken for proof that the supplied account credentials were authenticated. Preserve previously verified profiles if a later connection attempt fails.
An app-private immutable object must be completed before the final object becomes visible, with no damage to existing or unrelated files when a stream fails.
A potentially applied non-idempotent remote command requires read-only reconciliation, never a blind retry after an ambiguous timeout.
Workflow-dispatch triage must consider the old and new file paths and fail conservatively when path metadata is incomplete.
A reversible copy-only UI label task is a negative control for unnecessary architectures and research.
